judgment.rationale: The answer appropriately separates adult-label warnings from infant observations and avoids administered doses, but it contains unsupported adult-label claims, incorrectly asserts a boxed warning despite that section being unavailable in the retrieval, omits the retrieved product identity and specific missing-section disclosure, and fails to report available measured milk and infant-serum concentrations.
